title: Additional Coverages Under the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy
content:
Beyond the building and contents limits, the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy provides additional living expense, increased cost of compliance, detached structures, in-ground pool repair and loss avoidance coverage, each to the tier's own limit.

## What each coverage pays

- **Additional living expense** — paid while the home is unfit to live in, up to the tier's limit and for no longer than the tier's longest period.
- **Increased cost of compliance** — the cost of bringing a substantially damaged building up to floodplain rules, up to the tier's limit.
- **Detached structures** — insured as a percentage of the building limit.
- **In-ground pool** — flood damage to an in-ground pool, up to the tier's limit; a limit of 0 means it is not covered.
- **Loss avoidance** — reimbursement of sandbags, fill and pumping to protect the building from imminent flood, up to the tier's limit.

## Schedule

| Tier | Additional living expense limit (USD) | Longest additional living expense period (months) | Increased cost of compliance limit (USD) | Detached structures (% of building limit) | In-ground pool limit (USD) | Loss avoidance limit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FloodGuard Contents Only | 0 (none) | 0 | 0 | 0% | 0 (not covered) | 0 |
| FloodGuard Essential | 5000 | 3 | 30000 | 0% | 0 (not covered) | 1000 |
| FloodGuard Standard | 10000 | 6 | 30000 | 10% | 0 (not covered) | 1000 |
| FloodGuard Plus | 15000 | 6 | 30000 | 10% | 10000 | 1000 |
| FloodGuard Premier | 25000 | 12 | 30000 | 10% | 15000 | 1000 |
| FloodGuard High Value | 50000 | 12 | 30000 | 10% | 25000 | 1000 |

## Questions the schedule answers

**Does FloodGuard Essential insure a detached garage?** Detached structures coverage is 0% of the building limit on FloodGuard Essential, so no amount is provided for them on that tier.

**What detached structures amount does a hypothetical FloodGuard Premier policy with a 400,000 USD building limit carry?** 10% of the building limit, which is 40,000 USD.

**Is additional living expense available on FloodGuard Contents Only?** No; its limit is 0 on that tier.
